title: Stream Freely.
Donate Privately.
index.description: The real-time donation alert box built for everyone. Let your fans support your stream without revealing who you are.

steps.title: 1. Prepare Your Payment Gateway
steps.description: Ensure you have an active account with a supported provider like Stripe, Ko-fi, or Buy Me a Coffee.

steps.title: 2. Create Your Profile
steps.description: Sign up on Alertbox.org to generate your custom, privacy-focused streamer profile.

steps.title: 3. Connect via Webhook
steps.description: Link your payment gateway using our secure webhook so we can trigger alerts when you receive a donation.

steps.title: 4. Customize Your Alert Box
steps.description: Adjust the design, colors, and layout of your alerts to perfectly match your stream's aesthetic.

steps.title: 5. Add Overlay to OBS
steps.description: Copy your unique overlay URL and paste it as a Browser Source in your broadcasting software.

steps.title: 6. Go Live!
steps.description: You are all set. We handle the overlay and profile, while your funds go directly to you.

steps_for_viewer.title: 1. Visit Profile (Optional)
steps_for_viewer.description: Go to the streamer's Alertbox.org page or click their direct donation link.

steps_for_viewer.title: 2. Make a Donation
steps_for_viewer.description: Pay securely through trusted platforms like Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, or Ko-fi.

steps_for_viewer.title: 3. You're on Screen!
steps_for_viewer.description: That's it! Your support instantly triggers a live alert on their stream.

faq.q: How is EasyDonate different from us?

ezdn: EasyDonate triggers an alert only when a donor uploads a bank transfer slip for verification, and the funds are transferred directly to the streamer's bank account.
alertbox_org: However, we trigger alerts instantly when a donor makes a purchase, subscribes, or donates. Payment gateway providers like Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, or Ko-fi send us a Webhook event to display the alert in real-time.
This method protects the streamer's personal information, as the donor pays the payment gateway provider first before the funds are ultimately transferred to the streamer.

ezdn: EasyDonate's free tier only allows up to 10 donation alerts per month and may display ads on the donation page.
Please learn more about %EasyDonate's pricing here%.
alertbox_org: We are a non-profit platform. We charge zero platform fees. The only fees you incur are those deducted directly by your chosen payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi), which are entirely out of our control.
Because of this, our only source of revenue to maintain and keep Alertbox.org and tip-to.me running is through donations from our users.

disclaimer: We at AlertBox.org have no affiliation, partnership, or personal relationship with the management of EasyDonate.
AlertBox.org was created by a small group of passionate developers who share the same ideal:
"True innovation flourishes when knowledge is free"
Our intention in building AlertBox.org is not to destroy market competitors. We simply want to provide another alternative for everyone.
Built by humans, for humans, on Earth.

footer.description:
Alertbox.org is an open-source alert box service featuring custom streamer profiles, zero platform fees, and robust privacy protection. 
Powered by trusted payment gateways like Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, and Stripe.
